title: Spending Resort Credit Standing on a Granite Ridge Season Pass Record
content:
## When this facility applies

Resort credit standing on a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass record is spent against the money that pass account still has to collect. The figure applied is the one the collective's basis for a credit application produces; the agent works it out from the records and the published terms and passes it in.

## The business effect

One application is booked on the pass account dated today, the resort credit left on that pass record drops by the figure applied and the amount still to be collected drops by the same figure, so the guest sees both numbers fall at once.

## How it is invoked

The agent unlocks the hidden agent tool `apply_pass_credit_52fe36c9` and then calls it. It is an agent-side tool and is not handed to the guest.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pass_id` | the reference number of the season pass record the credit sits on and whose pass account is being reduced | an identifier, as returned by the season pass lookup |
| `related_event_id` | the reference number of the pass account entry that issued the credit being spent | an identifier, read from the pass account entry lookup |
| `credit_pot` | which pot of resort credit the application is drawn from, exactly as the collective labels its credit | one of the six values below |
| `credit_applied_usd` | the resort credit spent in this single application | a fixed-format figure in USD to 2 decimal places, never negative and booked exactly as given |

The complete set of values `credit_pot` takes:

- `none` — the entry touches no credit pot at all
- `pass_cancellation` — credit issued because a pass was given up
- `downgrade_differential` — credit issued because a pass was moved to a lower tier
- `service_recovery` — credit issued to put right a day or a service the collective failed to deliver
- `protection_settlement` — credit issued because a protection claim was settled in credit
- `duplicate_charge` — credit issued to put right an amount the collective charged twice

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence carrying the new pass account entry reference, a string beginning `pcrd_`, the pass record reference, the credit pot drawn from, the figure applied in USD to 2 decimal places, the resort credit left on that pass record and the amount still to be collected afterwards, both in USD to 2 decimal places. The presence of that entry reference is what indicates the application was recorded.
